# openwrt_dropbear (Resource)

Manages OpenWrt Dropbear SSH server settings.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Instance name (e.g., 'main').

### Optional

- `password_auth` (Boolean) Enable password authentication.
- `port` (Number) SSH listen port (default: 22).
- `root_login` (Boolean) Enable root login.
- `root_password_auth` (Boolean) Enable root password authentication.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID: dropbear/<instance_name>.
- `section_name` (String) Internal UCI section identifier (e.g. 'cfg0abc12') of the anonymous section backing this resource. Managed automatically; resolved on import.
